verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented system-to-system channel: formation runs on fillable PDFs submitted by upload, fax, or mail, and the franchise-tax portal is a keyless web form behind an image CAPTCHA. Probes found no OpenAPI spec or other machine-readable endpoints, and no system-account, transmitter, or batch-provider program or enrollment path is published. Registered agents are noted only as a de facto service layer, with no documented machine interface.
